_comment: English body for dingtalk-ai; generated from the Chinese dossier and official pages, not a literal translation.

axes.model_access: Driven by DingTalk’s AI assistant; the specific model, tiers and availability vary by enterprise edition and region.
axes.runtime: Runs in DingTalk’s cloud, with entry points in messages, documents, meetings, calendar and the workbench; the local client only handles interaction.
axes.local_files: Can read documents, messages, meetings and approvals the organisation is authorised to access; local files must be uploaded.
axes.background: Meeting notes, message summaries and workflow tasks are triggered in their own surfaces; there is no cross-organisation persistent background agent.
axes.tools: Integrated with DingTalk messages, docs, calendar, approvals, low-code and bots; extensible through the open platform.
axes.context: Context comes from content the organisation can access plus the current conversation; cross-organisation retrieval is limited by permissions. Cross-document and cross-session memory is limited, so complex work needs manual context and source citations.
axes.permissions: Enterprise admins control features, data scope and logs; commercial use and data residency follow the DingTalk contract.
axes.fit: Fits: meeting notes, message summaries and process assistance for teams already deep in DingTalk. Does not fit: a cross-platform unified knowledge base.
